translations.answer: It is essential to record the test load inertia, torque amplitude, temperature, and sampling rate: use a step test to measure rise time/overshoot, use a sweep to obtain the -3 dB bandwidth, and perform multiple torque point precision, forward and reverse repeat, and anti-drivability with long-term thermal drift. This post provides a validation framework rather than specific pass/fail thresholds.
translations.applicability: Not a industry standard; thresholds must be defined according to platform, safety level, and sensor precision.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: Step and sweep, 10/50/100% rated torque static precision, forward and reverse repeat, sawtooth resolution, power-off/zero torque anti-drivability, long-term thermal drift.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Cross-verified by the text, visible comments, and media descriptions; not independently verified by the paper, source code, or official documentation.
translations.details.environments.0: High sampling rate external torque sensor; unloaded and loaded; locked rotation; above 1–100 Hz sweep.
translations.details.limits.0: Not an industry standard; thresholds must be defined according to platform, safety level, and sensor precision.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Establishes a validation framework, but the post does not provide actual measured data.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: How to avoid misjudging force control joints based on vendor-provided '100 Hz bandwidth'?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Community candidate is only for forming diagnostic hypotheses; when involving real machines, limit speed, limit force, isolate personnel, and retain logs.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Unloaded small test masking loaded bandwidth decline, hysteresis, thermal drift, and gear resistance.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Measured nominal torque precision/bandwidth lacks load, amplitude, and temperature conditions; real machine performance is not comparable.
translations.media_summaries.0: A single media entry lacks readable step or Bode curve; validation framework comes from the text, but bandwidth and precision are not shown with real-time numbers on the graph.
